verdict.rationale: First-party material says every document becomes part of the agent's knowledge base, with chat-with-your-docs and RAG working out of the box. Community users confirm configurable embedders and vector stores. A hands-on test on regulatory PDFs got largely correct grounded answers, though the citations window showed garbled content. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on document ingestion and supported formats (including notes), and reliable citation display to show answers are grounded.
